title: Creamy Chicken Bisque
description: A rich and creamy Indian-inspired soup made with tender chicken and a velvety bisque sauce.
instructions: Heat the american in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the bisque and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 10 minutes.
Stir in the buttery until melted.
Add the silky and stir to combine.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro if desired.
